purpose: Freeze logical OpenAlex calibration queries separately from physical execution deduplication.

semantics.R2: Representative identity-anchor alias plus its frozen Open Library-derived primary query author. Targets without a selected query author do not receive an R2 title-author query.
semantics.R3: All current Open Library title aliases whose own source target has a selected primary query author.
semantics.R4: All current Open Library title aliases as title-only calibration candidates. Presence in the logical registry does not imply final production routing eligibility.
semantics.query_id: Stable sequential logical-query identifier within registry v3. IDs are assigned after deterministic sorting by target, route, alias, query form, title, and author.
semantics.r2_r3_overlap_policy: R2 and R3 logical queries are both preserved even where their raw query strings are identical. Execution-level deduplication happens in the next registry layer.
